name: Kawaisou na Fuukei
source:
Main character finds pleasure in watching girls being insulted. He stays as a bystander to the end to see the result with his eyes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公从目睹少女受辱的过程中获得快感。他始终以旁观者的身份留在一旁，亲眼看清最后的结果。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
